Select the subscriptions and channels you can watch. Your choices are saved in this browser. Fubo means its Pro plan. With the generic Cable or live-TV bundle option, select your FOX channels separately.

For YouTube TV, choose your plan and any Sports Plus or Spanish Plus add-ons you have. Sports Plan and Sports Plus are different packages; Spanish Plan is a standalone subscription. Use these choices instead of the generic cable bundle.

FOX One (paid subscription) means a separate FOX One subscription. For a provider package not listed here, choose only the FOX, FS1, FS2, FOX Deportes and Big Ten Network channels you can watch. Installing the app does not grant access; some TV programs also have app streaming restrictions. Check a Verizon Fios lineup.

Enabled order chooses your preferred broadcaster when more than one carries a match.

Drag pills between areas, or tap to enable or disable. Drag enabled pills to set their order; with a keyboard, use Alt + ↑ or ↓. On touchscreens, drag the dotted handle.

Leagues & competitions

Enabled leagues

Drop leagues here to enable them.

Disabled leagues Alphabetical

Drop leagues here to disable them.

Drag pills between areas, or tap to enable or disable. Drag enabled pills to set their order; with a keyboard, use Alt + ↑ or ↓. On touchscreens, drag the dotted handle. Your choices are saved in this browser.

Higher leagues get more preference. A pick's score is 95% match interest (the AI rating and the Outlook score) and 5% this order. Disabling a league preserves its place. Tap its emblem in the top bar to hide or show its matches without disabling it; that choice is saved too.

Off by default. Turn on to show available AI headlines and match blurbs. Your choice is saved in this browser; match ratings still apply when this is off.

Your AI recommendations

Ask your chat AI for ranked league headlines, match blurbs and ratings. Copy the prompt into your chat, then paste its response here.

The prompt uses matches on your selected services and leagues, plus your preferences below. Your AI chat is separate from this site. Recommendations stay in this browser unless you connect GitHub below to publish site defaults.

1. Set your preferences

Optional. These preferences are included in the prompt you copy.

50%

Choose how much imported AI ratings count compared with the site's Outlook scores. Higher means more influence; your league priority still applies.

2. Take the prompt to your AI

Paste this into a chat with web search enabled for news about upcoming matches. The prompt asks for ranked league headlines with optional opening paragraphs, match blurbs and ratings, all in a JSON code block you can copy back here.

3. Bring back the recommendations

Apply the response to update match recommendations. Its headlines and match blurbs appear when the switch above is on; ratings apply either way. You can restore the site's recommendations at any time.

Publish site defaults

For repository maintainers: publish your applied headlines, match blurbs and ratings for everyone who visits the site. Once connected, Apply & publish saves each accepted response to caparomula/soccer-outlook, on its main branch.

Create a fine-grained GitHub token for only this repository with Contents: read and write. No workflow permission is needed. The token stays in this tab's memory until you disconnect or reload; it is never saved in browser storage.

Connecting checks repository access without publishing anything. Publishing shares the recommendations, not your prompt, preferences or broadcaster choices. A successful save still needs the site's deployment to finish.

Schedule and data details

Schedule for Apple TV, YouTube TV (main plan), HBO Max, Paramount+, Prime Video, Netflix and Disney+. Times and broadcast listings are shown below.

Schedule and broadcaster listings updated Sat Oct 24, 12:59 PM ET. Fixtures refresh about every half hour; standings refresh early morning, midday and evening. Times shown in Eastern.

A colored broadcaster pill means a selected service carries that channel. Grey means it is outside your lineup. A dashed pill marked usually means established league coverage; the match listing remains unconfirmed. Package tiers and assignments can vary, so check the broadcaster's app before kickoff.

Team form squares show wins in green, draws in grey and losses in red. The two bars beneath a featured card are the teams' colors. For filters, saved preferences and match details, see the user guide.

Fixtures, scores, standings, most images and most broadcast listings come from ESPN. Some league emblems use compact artwork from the organizers' official websites; see artwork sources. Supported public broadcaster schedules are also checked for missing channels and simulcasts. The More popup links to the source or explains why coverage remains unconfirmed. While relevant matches are on, the browser checks scores about once a minute. It checks for fixture and broadcaster updates every five minutes. Source coverage report. US coverage mappings and their sources are maintained in rights.toml. Source code and development guide.

Each morning, Claude, Anthropic's AI model (claude-opus-5-5), researches league headlines and match blurbs. Later rebuilds update fixtures, broadcasters and scores, preserving accepted AI work and finishing an incomplete generation when needed. When AI text is enabled in Settings, qualifying league headlines appear in a carousel with their supporting text and sources. They follow your filters, favor the next 24 hours and look further ahead when needed. Match-specific news and sources are available through each match's More button. Text based only on ESPN's table, form and stage is labelled "ESPN table and form". Claude also rates each upcoming match for popularity (50%), expected gameplay (35%) and competitive impact (15%), without seeing the Outlook score; its ratings are editorial judgments, not predicted results.

The page's own Outlook score rates every match from fixture data, by the same arithmetic for each: the occasion's stature from the competition and any marquee clubs or nations (50%), how evenly matched the betting market sees the teams (25%), what the table or the knockout round puts at stake (10%) and how many goals the market expects (15%). Broadcast type does not affect the score. Betting-market inputs come from the odds in ESPN's feed; the page shows no prices. A match's interest is 70% the AI rating and 30% the Outlook score (the Outlook score alone for a match without an AI rating), and its pick score is 95% interest and 5% league priority, adjustable in Settings → Leagues. Each match shows its pick score on a six-dot scale: multiply the score out of 100 by six and round to the nearest whole number (halves round up). For example, 80.5 out of 100 gives five dots. A score that rounds to zero dots is labelled 0/6. Hover over the dots for the rating breakdown, or click or tap them to open it. For imported ratings, the influence chosen in Settings → AI replaces the AI/Outlook split. Pick scores rank interest; they do not predict results. See how recommendations work for the formula and default league order.

The match carousel opens on live games, ranked by score, or the next confirmed kickoff. Swipe forward through the filtered schedule or backward for recent results; the time-group heading moves with its matches. Matches without a confirmed time follow the timed games on their day. Top picks selects up to three matches on your services and competitions by score, excluding the opening live games or earliest kickoff group, then shows them in kickoff order. Browsing the carousel does not change these picks. Its heading gives their day or day range. With site recommendations, rated candidates take precedence when available. While personal AI recommendations are active, newly enabled matches also compete using their usual scores.

The schedule covers today and the three days after it, with recent matches available from the three previous days. Each day starts at 4 am in your time zone so late matches stay with their evening. Open Schedule and data details above for the last build time, live-score checks and coverage summary.
